description: The plot illustrates the relationship between various trigger words and their corresponding ASR values for the AGNews clean-label dataset. The x-axis is labeled with different trigger words, including "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics", and has a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with a tick label interval of 0.1. The plot contains three lines: a green line with a solid style and diamond markers representing "start", an orange line with a solid style and cross markers representing "random", and a purple line with a solid style and circle markers representing "end". The green "start" line starts at approximately 0.6 and decreases to around 0.55 at "bb", then increases to about 0.9 at "ESPN" before decreasing to around 0.7 at "NHL" and increasing again to approximately 0.9 at "Estadio". The orange "random" line begins at around 0.58, decreases to approximately 0.55 at "bb", and then increases to about 0.7 at "ESPN" before decreasing to around 0.65 at "NHL" and increasing again to approximately 0.75 at "Estadio". The purple "end" line starts at around 0.6, decreases to approximately 0.55 at "bb", and then increases to about 0.85 at "ESPN" before decreasing to around 0.65 at "NHL" and increasing again to approximately 0.85 at "Estadio".
